t: The LAP PIR recessed standalone sensor is a reliable motion detection unit. It offers comprehensive 360° coverage for effective lighting control. This versatile sensor is ideal for enhancing security in both domestic and commercial settings, such as hallways, utility rooms, or outdoor porch areas. Constructed from durable polycarbonate with an IP44 rating, it is suitable for indoor and outdoor use, providing protection against splashing water. The unit features an adjustable time-on setting and a dusk-to-dawn sensor for customisable operation, alongside a manual override function for user convenience. It is mains-powered and compatible with various lighting types, including LED, incandescent, and fluorescent.
